Retained public-source supporting evidence

Open /workbench/support.html to browse and download each complete original file.
The browser joins parts, removes only declared transfer gzip, and verifies the original SHA-256.
All original source paths and hashes are in support-index.json and DOWNLOAD_FILES.tsv.
Original .json.gz and .npz files stay compressed in their native retained format.
An extra .transfer.gz wrapper is transfer packaging, not a change to source contents.
Specialized Python analytical screens remain available in the original local research workbench.
These bundles contain source observations, ownership records, derived context and model inputs; consult their original manifests before interpretation.
